keyEvents.text: Erick Pulgar (Flamengo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Rodrigo Castillo (Fluminense).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Lucho Acosta (Fluminense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Saúl (Flamengo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Agustín Canobbio (Fluminense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Fluminense. Ganso replaces Lucho Acosta.
Substitution, Fluminense. Kevin Serna replaces Yeferson Soteldo.
Substitution, Flamengo. Bruno Henrique replaces Pedro.
Substitution, Flamengo. Joaquín Freitas replaces Saúl.
Goal! Flamengo 1, Fluminense 0. Jorge Carrascal (Flamengo) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Lucas Paquetá.
Substitution, Fluminense. Hulk replaces Rodrigo Castillo.
Substitution, Fluminense. Jefferson Savarino replaces Agustín Canobbio.
Substitution, Fluminense. Wesley Natã replaces Martinelli.
Substitution, Flamengo. Nicolás de la Cruz replaces Samuel Lino.
Substitution, Flamengo. Gonzalo Plata replaces Lucas Paquetá.
Ignácio (Fluminense) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Guilherme Arana (Fluminense) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Flamengo. Danilo replaces Jorge Carrascal.
Delay in match because of an injury Danilo (Flamengo).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Joaquín Freitas (Flamengo) is shown the yellow card.
